issue.title: sql: schema change job retries in a tight loop when the descriptor is offline
issue.body:
**Describe the problem**

After upgrading to v23.1.0-alpha, a schema change job on an offline table retries its failed step thousands of times per second and pins a CPU.

**Expected behavior**

The job should back off between retries.

Jira issue: CRDB-24990

comments.body: Confirmed: the job retries without any backoff and spins at 100% CPU while the descriptor is offline.
Hi @dt, please add branch-* labels to identify which branch(es) this release-blocker affects.
Seeing the tight retry loop again on 24.2 after the backoff default changed; see #127000.
